cohort: The study included all maternal deaths and live births recorded at the Obafemi Awolowo University Teaching Hospital (OAUTHC) in Nigeria between October 2012 and September 2015.
finding: The average maternal mortality ratio at OAUTHC, Nigeria, between October 2012 and September 2015 was extremely high at 1640/100,000 live births, with pregnancy-related infection being the leading cause.
